brief:
A Palestinian university has opened enrollment for the upcoming academic year, according to Ma'an Wire. The institution is welcoming applications from prospective students embarking on studies in science and related fields. The application deadline is set for September 19, 2026, with candidates able to submit their materials through the university's online portal.

The enrollment initiative represents the university's effort to recruit students for advanced study and professional development. The timing of the announcement allows applicants several months to complete and submit their application materials before the September deadline.
